newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine supermarket sales up in August - official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine supermarket sales up in August - official.

text.p: Supermarket sales in Argentina totaled $1.26 billion in August, $1.13 billion in July, $1.15 billion in June and $1.10 billion in May, the INDEC national statistics insitute said Wednesday.

INDEC said the new indicator, however, was not yet an appropriate gauge of consumption rates because new supermarket chains or branches are currently opening up in Argentina at a fast pace, while smaller food outlets are closing.
INDEC said it was better to track sales per square meter and average revenue per sale.
Sales per square meter rose to $1.16 billion in August from $1.13 in July and were flat against June.
The average revenue per sale was $27.3 in August, $26.7 in July, $27.6 in June and 26.7 in May.
